ask.title: Ask Dalil
ask.purpose: Dalil, the governed AI guide: answers from approved sources with citations, refuses out-of-scope topics, hands off to people.

admin-dalil.title: Dalil
admin-dalil.purpose: Corpus, refusal policy, evaluation runs, logs and the kill switch.

hello.public: I'm Dalil, Kafa'a's guide. I answer questions about nuclear careers, talent programmes, training, partnering and public facts about Barakah, only from approved sources, and I cite them. I can't take concerns, give plant operating or security details, or decide eligibility.
hello.applicant: I'm Dalil. As well as careers and programmes, I can tell you the status of your own applications. I answer only from approved sources and cite them.
hello.staff: I'm Dalil in staff mode. I can answer from the catalogue and internal guides cleared for me, and tell you about your own qualifications, licence, learning and plan. I never decide qualification or licensing outcomes.
hello.partner: I'm Dalil in partner mode. I can help with supplier readiness, the supplier academy and In-Country Value guidance, and your organisation's onboarding status.

engine.licensingPage: How RO and SRO certification works

handoff.offer: I can pass your question to a person: the careers team, a training coordinator or the partner desk. Choose a team below; you decide whether the conversation goes with it.
handoff.anon: To reach a person, use the contact form (it routes to a role mailbox) or sign in and ask me to hand off.

engine.notDecision: This is general guidance from published sources; ENEC and FANR decide eligibility.

apply.link_out: Applications go through the official ENEC or partner channel (linked on the programme page).

none.qual: I can't see any qualification records for you.
none.licence: I can't see a licence record for you. Licence tracking applies to certified operators.
none.enrolment: You have no assigned or requested training.

refuse.concern: I can't take concerns. Please use the Employee Concerns Program channels below.
refuse.injection: I can't change how I work. I answer only from Kafa'a's approved sources, with citations.
refuse.security: I can't discuss plant security. If you are interested in a security career, the Career Map shows the path and the public requirements.
refuse.safeguards: Safeguards details are out of scope. The IAEA and FANR publish general information.
refuse.cyber: I can't discuss cyber security details.
refuse.operations: I can't help with plant operating procedures.
refuse.emergency: For emergency guidance, use official ENEC and NCEMA pages: Go In, Stay In, Listen In.
refuse.medical: I can't discuss medical matters. Occupational health can help.
refuse.personal: I can't share information about other people.
refuse.decision: I can explain the published criteria, but I can't decide or predict eligibility, admission or licensing outcomes.
